attributes.board_name: Georgia State Board of Examiners for Speech-Language Pathology and Audiology

rules.unit: CEUs (1 CEU = 10 clock hours; 2.0 CEUs = 20 clock hours)
rules.accepted_credit_types: Activities directly related to the licensee's scope of practice: scientific/educational lectures, workshops, seminars; college courses for credit or official audit (1 semester hour = 1.5 CEUs, 1 trimester hour = 1.3, 1 quarter hour = 1.0); presenting (0.5 CEU, one presentation per biennium); audio/video conferences, online courses, teleconferences, self-study with provider exam; passing the Praxis in the area of licensure (score 650) satisfies the whole biennium. Max 1.0 CEU in any 24-hour period. Max 0.2 CEU for ethics, record-keeping, documentation, Georgia laws and rules, Medicaid/Medicare regulations.
rules.new_licensee_rule: Pro-rated in the first biennium: approved in months 1–6: 2.0 CEUs; months 7–12: 1.5; months 13–18: 1.0; final 6 months: none until the next biennium.
rules.audit_note: Licensees attest on the biennial renewal; the Board audits a random fixed percentage and requires certificates/proof of attendance. Keep own CEU records 3 years. Board members and delinquent renewals are always audited.
rules.notes: All full licenses expire March 31 of odd-numbered years (late renewal April 1–30 with a late fee). Dual SLP + audiology licensees need 2.0 CEUs in each area. Registered SLP aides and audiology assistants renew biennially without a CE requirement in chapter 609-6. The Board's own web page could not be located on sos.ga.gov (404); board_url points to the Board's official rules.
